title: ovieda picardae
intro: Ovieda picardae, commonly known as "Ovieda", is a plant species that belongs to the family Fabaceae. It is native to the tropical regions of Central and South America and has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Ovieda picardae include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to alleviate symptoms of conditions such as arthritis and other inflammatory diseases. The bioactive constituents of Ovieda picardae include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions of reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and acting as an antimicrobial agent.
